questions.stem: In assessing a patient's kidney function, understanding the factors that affect glomerular filtration rate (GFR) is crucial. Which of the following conditions will increase the glomerular filtration rate?
questions.stemHtml: In assessing a patient's kidney function, understanding the factors that affect glomerular filtration rate (GFR) is crucial. Which of the following conditions will increase the glomerular filtration rate?

options.label: A
options.text: Afferent Arteriolar Constriction, Efferent Arteriolar Dilation

options.label: B
options.text: Afferent Arteriolar Dilation, Efferent Arteriolar Constriction

options.label: C
options.text: Afferent Arteriolar Constriction, Efferent Arteriolar Constriction

options.label: D
options.text: Afferent Arteriolar Dilation, Efferent Arteriolar Dilation
